evidence.title: VentureBeat names Rob Strechay as its first Lead Analyst, expanding its enterprise AI research push

summary: VentureBeat has named Rob Strechay as its inaugural Lead Analyst, signaling a strategic expansion of its enterprise AI research efforts. The move aims to deepen the outlet's coverage and insights in the growing AI business sector.
title: VentureBeat Appoints First Lead Analyst to Boost Enterprise AI Research
